title: Strawberries and Cream Sheet-Pan Pancake
changes_from_base: The batter is baked in one tray at 220 °C with some cooked strawberries folded in, then cut into squares and topped with a cream-cheese whipped cream and the strawberry syrup.
summary: A generous sheet of fluffy pancake baked golden with cooked strawberries folded in and topped with a cloud of vanilla cream and berry syrup.

steps.title: Make batter
steps.text: Whisk 383 g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ tsp bicarbonate of soda, ½ tsp fine salt and 95 g caster sugar. Whisk 480 ml full-fat buttermilk (room temperature), 3 large eggs (room temperature), 86 g unsalted butter (melted) and 2 tsp vanilla, add to the flour and stir until just combined (lumpy); rest 10-15 min.

steps.title: Fold and spread
steps.text: Lift about 120 ml berries from their juice with a slotted spoon and fold into the batter. Spread in the tray, spreading the berries evenly; keep the rest with their syrup.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until puffed and golden and a cocktail stick comes out clean (about 20 min); cool 5 min.

steps.title: Make cream
steps.text: Whip 90 ml double cream to medium-stiff peaks (1-2 min); beat 113 g cream cheese (softened), 28 g icing sugar, 30 ml double cream, 1 tsp vanilla and ⅛ tsp fine salt smooth on medium; fold in the whipped cream.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Dust with icing sugar, cut into squares and serve warm with soft butter, the cream and the berries in syrup.

tips: Make the strawberry mixture up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled in an airtight container—it saves time and the flavours deepen.
The batter should be lumpy; stirring it just until combined prevents overdeveloping the gluten.
Dust the baked pancake with icing sugar just before serving for a fresh finish.
storage: The strawberry mixture can be made 1 day ahead and chilled airtight; the pancake is best warm, and leftovers keep 4 days airtight and reheat gently in the oven. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
